title: narcissus rupicola subsp. auricolor
intro: Narcissus rupicola subsp. auricolor, commonly known as the Auriculated Rock Narcissus, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against various diseases and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus rupicola subsp. auricolor are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess anti-cancer and neuroprotective effects. Research on this plant has identified its potential in the treatment of various conditions, including cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, and microbial infections.
